About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Please state your consent ID and date when you contact us regarding your consent.

Located in a central area, Abraham Tel Aviv is surrounded by cafés, nightlife, and cultural spots, just steps from Rothschild Boulevard and a 20-minute walk to the beach and Jaffa. Guests can enjoy weekly events like live music, jam nights, and cultural activities. The rooftop, featuring a green garden, is a year-round favorite for music and drinks, while the lounge, guest kitchen, and bar provide welcoming spaces to connect. With its location right next to the light rail station, exploring the city couldn’t be easier.

Abraham Bohol is a fantastic getaway experience for those wanting to make great summer memories as well as unforgettable exploration ventures in the untouched beauty of Bohol’s nature sites. As part of the globally-recognized Abraham brand of hospitality and its goal to be an international hub that welcomes people from various walks of life, it provides tours and a fun and comfortable place to stay for its guests with a warm smile and excellent service..

Szymon Krupka
1 day ago
Our family spent four nights at Abraham Bohol, and it was the perfect choice. What truly makes this place special is the incredible atmosphere. Every evening, we naturally gravitated toward the central area to listen to karaoke, sit at the tables, and talk with people from all over the world. It’s an amazing cultural hub for meeting fellow travelers. In fact, I ended up changing almost all my plans for those 4 days thanks to the people I met there and the experiences we shared. The resort itself is an excellent base for exploring the island. Our room completely met our expectations—it was large, spacious, and we were lucky to have one located right by the pool, which was incredibly convenient. Speaking of which, the massive swimming pools were a huge highlight for our family, and the breakfasts were very good and satisfying. I highly recommend this place to everyone! I’m definitely putting it on my list of places worth returning to. If you're looking for a comfortable, family-friendly spot with a real soul and great vibes, Abraham Bohol is the place to be!
